text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I have things I must accomplish.
I don't have time to stand still.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...So you're serious, Ikuno-san.
In that case—I won't hold back either.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's right! You must coordinate your legs, hips, and shoulders on unstable footing!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not yet!
Pouring a resolve strong enough to cut through the rapids into my legs—!
Ikuno Dictus told me there was something she wanted me to check... and for some reason, we ended up at a dojo.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing is believing.
Feast your eyes upon the results."
The wind pressure from Ikuno Dictus's straight punch grazed my cheek a split second later...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu. You humble me.
All of this is thanks to the Kongo Yaegaki style—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Proof that I've pulverized the fat!
Being lighter on my feet gave speed to my fists! Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Martial arts are well-suited for toning the body...
and you have great aptitude, Ikuno-san.
If you ever want to learn seriously, please let me know.
Relieved that her weight had returned to normal, I was nevertheless left breaking into a cold sweat over Ikuno Dictus's hidden talents.
